excerpt.zh:
空洞之点尖的宁静之感静谧地充斥着我们的心灵。一副幻景阴沉地在我们眼前展开。

我们观察到万古之争在瞬间瓦解——文明崩溃，历史抹消，死去的暴君雕像被时间埋葬。

空洞之点尖的智慧就在于无为的低调力量。冲突起起落落，而我们长存。这种超然使我们的领袖重获长生，从凡欲的噬骨之毒中解脱。

The serenity of the Hollow Point fills our minds with its silence. A vision stretches languidly into our senses.

We observe eons of strife unravelling in an instant - civilizations crumbling, histories erased, statues of long-dead tyrants buried by time.

The wisdom of the Hollow Point is in the quiet strength of abstention. Conflicts rise and fall, yet we remain. This detachment imbues our leaders with a newfound longevity, liberated from the corrosive toxicity of mortal grievance.

summary.text:
# 节制之力 / The Strength of Abstention

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:8043-8086`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5819-5854 (on_patron_delve_failed: 28 events × 100, utopia.3002 × 1)`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:8,109-114 (attunement ±50/100/200; 30-year retrigger 10800 days)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

潜入虚境但没有找到其他事件（on_patron_delve_failed）时，从28个权重各为100的遭遇（另有权重1的 utopia.3002 兜底）中随机抽取一个满足条件的；每次潜入失败只出现一个遭遇，不会依次经历全部。要求与小赞助者“空洞之点尖”已完成接触、未在“自寻出路”、处于月窠或器具领域之一，每个帝国一次。

When a Shroud delve finds nothing else (on_patron_delve_failed), one eligible encounter is drawn at random from 28 candidates of weight 100 each (plus utopia.3002 at weight 1 as fallback); each failed delve shows one encounter, never all of them in sequence. Requires completed contact with the minor patron the Hollow Point, not forging its own path, and being in the domain of the Cradle or the Instrument; once per empire.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

空洞之点尖展示无为的力量。

The Hollow Point reveals the quiet strength of abstention.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一选项：提示称所有领袖获得延长寿命特质（+40年）；脚本实际只给带灵能特质的领袖。

Only option: the tooltip says all leaders gain the Increased Lifespan trait (+40 years); the script only gives it to leaders with a psionic trait.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

对照原文核实了触发、选项与回复事件；草稿结构正确（选项→各自的回复窗口，互斥）。本遭遇与同池其他遭遇相互独立，不应串成一条故事。

Trigger, options and reply events were checked against the source; the draft structure is right (each option → its own reply window, mutually exclusive). This encounter is independent of the others in the pool and must not be chained with them.

不确定 / Uncertain:

- Tooltip says all leaders; the effect is limited to has_psionic_leader_trait = yes (events/shroud_events.txt:8074-8083).
